description: Frontend: Knowledge Base page, citation rendering in chat, and KB document selector in chat composer
steps: 1. Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/knowledge/page.tsx: Knowledge Base page with document list (card grid showing name, status badge, chunk_count, tags, upload date), upload button for PDF/DOCX/TXT (drag-drop or click), delete button per document, and a search box for testing RAG search.
2. Create apps/web/src/components/knowledge/KBDocumentCard.tsx: card component showing document info with status badge (processing=yellow, ready=green, failed=red), chunk count, and delete button.
3. Create apps/web/src/components/knowledge/KBUpload.tsx: file upload component accepting PDF/DOCX/TXT, with drag-and-drop support, calling POST /api/v1/kb/documents.
4. Create apps/web/src/components/knowledge/KBSearch.tsx: search input + results display for testing RAG queries via POST /api/v1/kb/search.
5. Modify apps/web/src/hooks/useChat.ts: add 'citation' event handling in SSE processing. Add citations field to ChatMessage type. Store citation data when event: citation is received.

6. Modify apps/web/src/components/chat/MessageBubble.tsx: detect [^N] patterns in assistant text, render as superscript badges. On click, show a tooltip/popover with cited chunk text, source doc name, and page number. Accept citations prop.

7. Modify apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatComposer.tsx: add a 'Use Knowledge Base' toggle or document selector dropdown. When enabled, include kb_document_ids in the message payload sent via onSend. Fetch available KB documents from GET /api/v1/kb/documents.
8. Modify apps/web/src/hooks/useChat.ts sendMessage function: accept optional kbDocumentIds parameter, include in POST body as kb_document_ids.
9. Update apps/web/src/app/(app)/chat/[id]/page.tsx to pass kbDocumentIds from composer to sendMessage.
10. Add 'Knowledge Base' link to ChatSidebar navigation (apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatSidebar.tsx) between Settings and main nav.
11. Run pnpm build in apps/web/ to verify no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: Knowledge Base page renders at /knowledge route
Documents can be uploaded (UI shows upload component with proper file type filtering)
Document cards show status, chunk count, delete button
Citation markers [^N] in messages render as clickable superscript badges
Chat composer has KB document selector/toggle
pnpm build passes without TypeScript errors
Sidebar has Knowledge Base navigation link
